title: PatientKeeper Retorno
shortDescription: An administrative review prototype for canceled follow-ups: current source records, explicit responsibility and cited human review, with transparent recorded AMD inference and visible failures.
longDescription:
PatientKeeper Retorno helps clinic reception and coordination keep a canceled follow-up visible until its next administrative step is checked. Eight fictional cases show ownership, contact preference, pending appointments, historical rules and conflicting records. It does not diagnose, recommend treatment, send messages or change real appointments.

The reviewer asks an administrative question, examines current literal excerpts and explicitly selects checked sources for a cited card. Known conflicts and clinical questions require human handoff. Stale sources cannot be reused silently, and preparing a card does not close the task.

Day/night modes and a read-only doctor calendar support exploration. Ten calendar items for two fictional doctors link back to case review. Filters and month navigation change the view; they do not book appointments or define clinical follow-up intervals.

On October 12, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct ran in float32 on an AMD Radeon Pro W7900D through PyTorch HIP. Seven baseline cases produced two format-valid candidates and five rejected outputs. Including an assigned-context variant and an extra prompt attempt, three of nine outputs passed format checks. This is not semantic or clinical approval.

The recorded AMD panel binds a fixed question and its complete source context to the current case. It identifies replay, shows failures and confirms the GPU is off; it performs no live inference.

The October 5 administrative scaffold is disclosed. October 12 work adds source review, receipts, languages, model contracts, recorded inference, day/night modes and the fictional calendar. English is the default, with Portuguese and Spanish navigation. We aim to clarify administrative handoffs; business gains remain unmeasured.
additionalInformation:
Demo hosting: GitHub Pages. No login, API key or active GPU is needed. All cases are fictional and changes stay in the visitor’s browser.

Walkthrough: open Calendar, filter a fictional doctor, select a day and follow a linked case. Switch day/night modes and EN/PT/ES. In Case 04, open Review, choose Contact preference and Check sources; select the cited excerpt and explicitly confirm before preparing a card. Case 07 shows conflicting records and blocks the card. Original Portuguese evidence and recorded model outputs remain unchanged; reading translations are separate.

The repository preserves the pinned model, seven baseline inputs, all nine attempts, rejected outputs and the separate GPU shutdown receipt. Two of seven baseline outputs passed format checks; this is not semantic accuracy.

The updated video uses the same synthetic English Envato narration supplied by Athos, synchronized subtitles and edited real interface captures. The PDF and conceptual AI desk-calendar cover use the official FIGUEIRA wordmark; cover typography is Sequel with RETORNO in bold italic. October 5 pre-event scaffolding remains disclosed. October 12 additions and their evidence are identified.
